title: Denied Invoice Disputes and the Permanent Step Percentage — Commercial Credit Account
content:
Invoice disputes that the records contradicted take percentage points from **the step percentage used** on a permanent increase of a Commercial Credit Account.

### Clause

The step percentage used loses ten percentage points for an account with two or more disputes resolved denied less than twelve whole months before today, five points for an account with exactly one, and none otherwise.

The count is of the dispute resolution entries with outcome denied dated fewer than 12 whole months before today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the resolution date's day of the month. Disputes credited, withdrawn or referred to the Credit Department are not counted.

| Disputes resolved denied in that time | Points taken |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10 |
| exactly 1 | 5 |
| none | 0 |

*Hypothetical:* a step percentage of 50 percent with one denied dispute in the last 12 whole months becomes 45 percent.
